title: Seven New Jersey locations make country's most haunted list
excerpt: Several New Jersey boardwalks and casinos have ranked among America's most haunted gaming destinations.
content:
Oct. 22, 2026, 5:32 a.m. ET

Several New Jersey boardwalks and casinos have ranked among America's most haunted gaming destinations, according to a new study by online gambling company BetUS Casino.

The study analyzed hundreds of destinations nationwide, examining reported ghost sightings, Google reviews mentioning paranormal activity and online searches related to haunted locations.

Atlantic City's Maine Avenue Promenade ranked highest among the New Jersey destinations, with a haunting score of 5.58, three reported ghost sightings and an average of 1,140 monthly searches related to paranormal activity.

The Asbury Park Boardwalk ranked 18th nationally with a score of 5.41, followed by Bradley Beach Boardwalk at No. 19 with a score of 5.35. Both locations recorded five reported ghost sightings.

Three Ocean County destinations also made the list. Seaside Heights Boardwalk ranked 20th, followed by Seaside Park Boardwalk at No. 21 and Ortley Beach Boardwalk at No. 22.

Resorts Casino Hotel in Atlantic City rounded out New Jersey's appearances at No. 25, with a haunting score of 3.15.

The historic casino, which opened in 1978 as Atlantic City's first legal casino, has long been associated with local ghost stories. Its buildings previously served as a military hospital during World War II.

According to BetUS Casino, the rankings were based on data current as of Sept. 24, 2026.
